name: CREST Syndrome

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: American College of Rheumatology/European League Against Rheumatism (ACR/EULAR) 2013 Criteria for Systemic Sclerosis

criteria.description: Presence of calcinosis cutis confirmed clinically or radiographically
History of Raynaud phenomenon characterized by episodic digital ischemia
Evidence of esophageal dysmotility by manometry or barium swallow
Skin thickening limited to fingers and toes
Presence of multiple telangiectasias on skin
Presence of anticentromere antibodies in serum

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of Raynaud phenomenon and sclerodactyly plus at least one minor criterion (calcinosis, esophageal dysmotility, or telangiectasia)
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis is clinical and supported by serologic and imaging findings; limited cutaneous involvement distinguishes CREST from diffuse systemic sclerosis.

pathognomonic.notes: Episodic digital ischemia triggered by cold or stress
Skin thickening and tightening limited to fingers and toes
Dilated superficial blood vessels visible on skin

common.notes: Calcium deposits in skin and subcutaneous tissues
Impaired esophageal peristalsis causing dysphagia and reflux
Painful ulcers on fingertips due to ischemia

occasional.notes: Due to mild interstitial lung involvement
Difficulty swallowing related to esophageal involvement

rare.notes: Elevated pulmonary artery pressure leading to dyspnea
Sudden onset malignant hypertension and renal failure
Inflammation of skeletal muscles causing weakness

laboratory: Elevated ESR and CRP (nonspecific inflammatory markers)
Normal to mildly elevated creatine kinase
imaging: Chest X-ray showing interstitial lung changes
Hand X-rays showing soft tissue calcifications
genetic: No single causative gene identified; HLA associations reported
other: Nailfold capillaroscopy showing capillary dropout and dilatation

distinguishingFeatures: Overlapping features of systemic sclerosis, lupus, and polymyositis
High titers of anti-U1 RNP antibodies

redFlags: New onset severe dyspnea or hypoxia
Sudden onset malignant hypertension suggestive of renal crisis
references: American College of Rheumatology/European League Against Rheumatism Collaborative Initiative. 2013 Classification Criteria for Systemic Sclerosis.
LeRoy EC, Medsger TA Jr. Criteria for the classification of early systemic sclerosis.
Mayes MD. Epidemiology of systemic sclerosis and related disorders.
